novum_candidates.description: The necromancer's window/apparatus that displays and seemingly manifests any period of time (past pastoral Greenwich, transitional Greenwich, and a monstrous far-future city), grounded in the ancestor's 'arts and discoveries' concerning powers residing in this plot of ground and a will-based metaphysics that treats space and time as pliable.

novelty.rationale: The power to reveal/manifest any time through the window is a world-altering difference from the empirical norm, but it is presented as a localized occult 'spectacle' rather than a totalizing transformation of the story universe, so novelty is partial/ambiguous.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The account is explicitly framed as 'sartain arts,' necromancy, Indian rites, and 'powers,' with retributive supernatural vengeance (the black influx, the shriveling old man). It rests on magic and the supernatural rather than a coherent, systematic, immanent nonsupernatural logic, so cognitive validation is absent.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The window and the temporal visions drive the central encounter and its horrific climax; the narrator's scream at the future vision precipitates the catastrophe, so the device governs the overriding narrative logic.

novum_candidates.estrangement_rationale: The pastoral past and monstrous future glimpsed through the window contrast sharply with the narrator's modern New York, dislocating both reader and narrator, but the mechanism is occult rather than cognitively rationalized.

novum_candidates.description: The ice-fleshed, centuries-old necromancer who has preserved his ancestral seat and his own longevity through occult arts, ultimately destroyed by the returning dead Indians' supernatural vengeance.

novelty.rationale: An unnaturally long-lived, ice-cold being is a striking departure from the norm, but it is a single uncanny individual rather than a world-altering condition.

cognitive_validation.rationale: His longevity and destruction are explained by magic and supernatural retribution, not by any immanent nonsupernatural system.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: He is the story's central figure, but the governing engine of the plot is the temporal-vision demonstration and its consequences, of which he is the operator.

novum_candidates.estrangement_rationale: The ice-quality flesh and archaic costume estrange the reader, signaling something beyond mortal norms, yet framed as supernatural.
